name: How long does it take to install a new kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen sink installation can vary depending on the complexity of the job. A straightforward replacement of an existing sink with a similar model might take 2-4 hours. However, if modifications to the countertop are required, like enlarging the opening for a larger sink or changing from a drop-in to an undermount style, it could extend to 4-8 hours. Plumbing issues or additional modifications can further impact the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen sink installation typically takes 2-8 hours, depending on complexity, including countertop modifications and plumbing adjustments.
